tools.name: property_area
tools.description: One UK postcode district (England and Wales): Land Registry sold prices by property type with yearly change, average rent and gross rental yield by property type (ONS), flood warning areas within 3 km and warnings in force (Environment Agency), EPC energy ratings and police.uk crime. Area-level, no

tools.name: property_compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 UK postcode districts side by side: sold prices and yearly change, rents and gross yield, crime and flood areas, ranked by cheapest, highest yield, fastest rising, fewest flood areas and lowest crime. Costs $0.15 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: property_rents
tools.description: Average monthly private rent (ONS) for a UK council or the council of a postcode district: overall, by bedrooms (1 to 4+) and by property type, with the yearly change. Costs $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: property_flood
tools.description: Flood risk for one full UK postcode (England): Environment Agency flood warning areas within 1 km with their rivers or sea, and any flood warnings in force within 3 km right now. Costs $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: epc_areas
tools.description: Energy-rating (EPC) statistics for one council in England or Wales: share of homes or commercial buildings rated A to G, per postcode district. Area-level only, no addresses. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.
